email_note: No public email found after exhaustive search: (1) Instagram web_profile_info API for agelessspa22 returned a persistent schema error from Instagram's own backend ("Asset asset://laser.provider/ig_business_category_subvertical has been deleted") on every attempt (direct curl with x-ig-app-id header, multiple retries, WebFetch), so business_email/external_url could not be read directly from Instagram's official endpoint; this same call succeeded normally for other unrelated accounts, confirming it is an account-specific API bug, not a blocked tool. (2) Fell back to the imginn.com public mirror of the profile and 12 individual posts/carousels: no bio text or external_url was exposed by the mirror (rendered as 'undefined'), only images and captions. (3) Booksy business page full JSON-LD/HTML: no email field, no mailto link anywhere in the page source. (4) Searched for a Linktree or bio link: none found; IG external_url is not populated per the mirror and no separate link-in-bio service was referenced anywhere. (5) Facebook: no dedicated Facebook page found for this business (only unrelated same-name businesses in other cities). (6) Web search for the business name plus 'email' or 'contact' returned no email address, only Booksy, Yelp and Instagram listings. Real public contact channels are Booksy booking, the phone number above, and Instagram DM.

images_downloaded.curation_note: This account's real photo pool is unusually thin for gallery use: the vast majority of the ~25 real (non-graphic) images downloaded are either (a) Instagram marketing template graphics with quote text, benefit lists or logos baked directly into the image (e.g. 'Teen Eyebrows', 'The art of waxing', 'Why facials are not a luxury', 'Book your facial today 561-769-7333'), or (b) extreme macro clinical before/after or in-progress photos with closed eyes, visible redness/irritation, or clutter (electrolysis needle close-up, acne extraction close-up, sheet-mask and facial-mask application shots). Per the pipeline's strict gallery curation rule (no text overlays, no closed-eye mid-procedure shots, no clutter, only finished results with good lighting), NONE of these passed the bar for a results gallery grid. Only 3 real, clean, non-graphic photos were found across the entire pool: (1) a professional portrait of Angelica in a white lab coat in her studio, in front of the branded wall sign with fresh flowers, found inside a carousel post (used as hero-angelica.jpg); (2) an in-session shot of Angelica performing a facial/brow treatment on a client, wearing a lab coat with a certification patch, from Booksy service_photos (used as about-treatment.jpg); (3) a client relaxing with a hydrating sheet mask in the treatment room, from Booksy service_photos (used as about-ambiance.jpg, ambiance only, not a gallery result tile). A fourth image, a personal beach selfie of Angelica from a Booksy review photo, was kept ONLY as a small circular avatar next to her name/credentials (never as a gallery tile), per the rule that owner selfies are avatar-only. Per DESIGN.md's explicit fallback ('si quedan menos de 5 buenas fotos, usa menos secciones de galeria en vez de rellenar con malas'), the standalone photo gallery grid section was DROPPED from this build rather than filled with text-overlaid or closed-eye/clutter images; the 3 clean real photos are used instead in the hero and experience/about sections only.
